Review Schema Generator

Generate valid Review JSON-LD schema from your review details.

JSON-LD output





  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Pick the type of item reviewed.
  2. Enter the item name, your rating and the review.
  3. Add author and date (optional but recommended).
  4. Generate, copy and paste the JSON-LD into your page.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
How do I generate review schema?
Fill in the item reviewed, your rating, and the review text, then click Generate.
What can be reviewed?
Products, local businesses, movies, books and more — pick the type that fits.
Must the review appear on the page?
Google requires the review to be visible on the page for review rich results.
How do I use the output?
Copy the JSON-LD into your page and validate it with Google's Rich Results Test.
